Comment.value: Caster Signature Gear - Damage Retyper (roadmap: Gear-to-boost-specific-mage-spells). Effect is scripted in cg_retype_inc.nss, keyed off this Tag. Deliberately not placed anywhere yet - acquisition is an open design question.

value.0:
A splinter of bone sealed in cold silver, taken from a barrow whose name the chroniclers struck out. The powers of the deep places long ago learned to shrug off a summons to death; this reliquary does not argue with them. When the wearer calls down an Implosion, the collapsing weight is no longer a decree of death that the deathless may simply ignore -- it lands as raw divine force, and the proud are broken by it all the same.

Worn at the neck. Its power sleeps for any who is not a Cleric.
